name: ContentEntry
description: A content entry in Strapi v5. Content entries are instances of content-types with attributes directly accessible at the top level (flattened format).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique integer identifier for the content entry

fields.name: documentId
fields.description: The unique document identifier used as the primary key in REST API operations

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was last updated

fields.name: publishedAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was published, null if draft. Only present when Draft and Publish is enabled.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: Locale code (e.g., en, fr, de). Present when internationalization is enabled.
Additional fields defined by the content-type schema. In Strapi v5, all attributes are at the top level of the data object.

relationships.name: localizations
relationships.description: Localized versions of this entry (populated when using ?populate=localizations)
